nodes.name: When clicking ‘Execute workflow’
nodes.purpose: Entry trigger for local workflow execution and testing.

nodes.name: Query Input & Normalizer
nodes.purpose: Normalizes incoming coaching query, trims whitespace, validates non-empty string.

nodes.name: Greeting Classifier
nodes.purpose: Deterministic regex classifier separating pure greetings from substantive questions.

nodes.name: Greeting Router
nodes.purpose: Branches execution: True -> Static Greeting Response; False -> Ollama Query Embedder.

nodes.name: Static Greeting Response
nodes.purpose: Returns static welcome greeting; 100% bypasses embedding, PostgreSQL, and LLM generation.

nodes.name: Ollama Query Embedder
nodes.purpose: Embeds query using local bge-m3:latest via POST /api/embeddings.

nodes.name: Validate Query Vector
nodes.purpose: Validates exact 1,024 finite float dimensions; formats vector string for PostgreSQL.

nodes.name: Retrieve Framework Stream
nodes.purpose: Dedicated PostgreSQL pgvector query for stream_type = 'framework' with similarity >= 0.70, LIMIT 2.

nodes.name: Retrieve Voice Stream
nodes.purpose: Dedicated PostgreSQL pgvector query for stream_type = 'voice_sample' with similarity >= 0.65, LIMIT 2.

nodes.name: Merge Retrieval Streams
nodes.purpose: Merges independent framework and voice streams using mode 'append'.

nodes.name: Aggregate & Gate Results
nodes.purpose: Aggregates records, filters empty rows from alwaysOutputData, computes framework_count and voice_count.

nodes.name: Hard Gate (Has Results?)
nodes.purpose: Evaluates has_qualifying_results (total_qualifying_chunks > 0). True -> Grounded Prompt; False -> Zero Result Output.

nodes.name: Return Zero Result Output
nodes.purpose: Emits mandatory fallback 'No documented coaching frameworks match this topic.'; bypasses generation LLM.

nodes.name: Format Grounded Prompt
nodes.purpose: Builds grounded prompt with Section A (Frameworks), Section B (Voice tone/phrasing), Section C (User query), Section D (Constraints).

nodes.name: Ollama Grounded Generator
nodes.purpose: Generates grounded response via local llama3.2:1b at temperature 0.2, stream: false.

nodes.name: Format Final Response
nodes.purpose: Formats final response payload with response text, counts, and retrieval provenance metadata.
